text:
Sam: Quick two-question pocket poll — answer with the letter+number combo (e.g. A2).

Editors (pick one):
A) VSCode
B) Vim
C) Emacs
D) JetBrains
E) Nano

Sandwiches to stock in the office fridge (pick one):
1) Banh mi
2) Falafel wrap
3) Turkey & swiss
4) Caprese
5) Tuna melt

polly-bot: Poll created — drop a reply like `A2` or react. I will tally after a bit. :clipboard:

Anita: B2 — Vim + falafel, easy. :heart_eyes:

Maria: A3 — VSCode and turkey for the win. :sunglasses:

Josh: B2 — Vim forever. Falafel > tuna. :v: :sandwich:

Luca: D1 — Big IDE energy, and banh mi when available. :bread:

Maria: Actually A2 would be ideal if we can have both VSCode and falafel in peace. :grimacing:

Sam: Love the chaos. Leaving this up for ~10m then polly-bot, please close and post results. :clock1:

polly-bot: Poll closed by request. Tally: Editors — A(VSCode):2, B(Vim):2, C(Emacs):0, D(JetBrains):1, E(Nano):0. Sandwiches — 1(Banh mi):1, 2(Falafel wrap):3, 3(Turkey & swiss):1, 4(Caprese):0, 5(Tuna melt):0.

Sam: Nice — buying a batch of falafel wraps tomorrow. Tagging @ops to confirm fridge space. :tada:
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style; messages concatenated as one string, short informal replies, includes a poll bot and reactions via emoji codes.
